notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41113959/f6372222449c9956471bc635336ca13fe6136b2c.jpg[/img]

Totally Convenient is 1 year old!

To celebrate this event, I have made some adjustements to the game, including :
- bugfixes (sometimes finishing a level was saving the wrong score)
- difficulty balance (change the treshold for victory to some later levels)
- a new cartoonish look (elements of the game have a new shader and an outline)

AND

the game is 90% off for a week! The perfect occasion to grab it...

Also, I take this opportunity to tell you that I'm working on my next game and that this one will likely not receive updates anymore (except of course if new bugs are found).

I hope you'll have fun and please let me know your thoughts and opinions!

Have a good game,
Jonathan

notes.title: Update notes for March 16
notes.content:
Bug fixes and improvements :
- the annoying music now play for each level
- the game pause itself when unplugging the controller or tabbing out of the game
- fixed some geometry issues in some levels
- UI should now scale better with different resolutions like Ultra Wide Screen
- added Steam Cloud saves
- added 14 Steam achievements

There are still things I want to improve / add / polish, but those where the most important imho.
Enjoy!
